calibration_sources: LiveKit Agents / Pipecat Streaming Voice Pipeline Benchmarks: Semantic VAD/EOU vs. Silence Timers
Native Speech-to-Speech Realtime Audio Pricing vs. Streaming ASR + LLM + WebSocket TTS Unit Economics
Full-Duplex Semantic Barge-In & Backchannel Filtering Studies in Contact Center AI

workload.enterprise_scenario: 1,000-Seat Enterprise AI Contact Center (2,500,000 Call-Minutes/Month across Banking, Insurance & Airline Customer Support)
workload.target_sla: P99 Time-to-First-Audio (TTFA) <= 550.0 ms, 100.0% Mandatory Compliance Script & PII Redaction Gate, Cost <= $0.035/Minute
workload.key_architectural_insights: Pure Speech-to-Speech Omni models cost 6-8x more per minute ($0.19/min) and bypass deterministic text guardrails; Streaming Clause-Level Cascade + Semantic EOU + Emotion Tags hits 385ms TTFA at $0.031/min with 100% compliance.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统整句阻塞三段式级联 (800ms静音VAD -> 整句ASR -> 整段LLM -> 整段TTS · 2.92秒死寂)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Legacy Utterance-Blocking Batch Cascade (2,920ms P99 TTFA Dead Air)
tiers.voice_architecture: Fixed 800ms Silence Timer -> Batch Whisper -> Full Text LLM -> Full Audio File TTS
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern for live voice: nearly 3 seconds of silence after every user turn destroys natural phone conversation.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 纯原生端到端语音大模型 (100% 走 Realtime Audio API · 延迟低但月烧 $48万且难控合规话术)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Pure Native Speech-to-Speech Omni API ($480K/mo Audio Token Tax & Weak Text Gate)
tiers.voice_architecture: 100% Native Audio-In / Audio-Out Token Streaming Without Intermediate Text Guardrail Gate
tiers.recommended_for: Consumer emotional companion apps or low-volume VIP demos; cost-prohibitive and risky for regulated contact centers.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 流式分块级联 + 语义断句检测 (Streaming ASR + Semantic EOU + 首子句 6词流式 TTS)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Streaming Chunked Cascade (Streaming ASR + Semantic EOU + First-Clause Streaming TTS)
tiers.voice_architecture: Streaming ASR + 150ms Semantic Turn Detector + Text Guardrail Gate + 6-Token Clause WebSocket TTS
tiers.recommended_for: Mainstream enterprise voice contact centers needing 100% text-audited compliance and 86.5% lower cost than Omni APIs.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 混合双工语音终局 (Pre-EOU 投机预取 + 流式文本门控级联 + 副语言情绪标签 + 语义打断状态机)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Hybrid Duplex Voice Architecture (Speculative RAG + Text-Gated Cascade + Emotion Tags + Duplex Barge-In)
tiers.voice_architecture: Pre-EOU Speculative RAG + Acoustic Emotion Tagging ([angry]/[calm]) + Semantic Barge-In + Clause TTS
tiers.recommended_for: Regulated banking/insurance/airline voice AI gold standard: 385ms TTFA, 100% text compliance gate, and saves $402.5K/mo vs. Pure Omni.
